look: Out of the screen: a phone feed in a dark room, the real photo breaks out to full frame, then a dawn sky world with soft clouds and rooftop pads. Plain.

scenes.name: The feed
scenes.desc: A phone in the dark; a thumb scrolls a feed until the Roadster post stops it.

scenes.name: Breakout
scenes.desc: The photo pushes past the phone's edges and the screen falls away.

scenes.name: Real life
scenes.desc: The full photo on the salt flat, slow push; It is real.

scenes.name: Lift
scenes.desc: Dust kicks up, the car rises out of the photo as the camera tilts to the sky.

scenes.name: Sky world
scenes.desc: Concept: a dawn city above the clouds, rooftop pads, the car gliding past.
